messages.subject: Project Skylark - licensing RapidCure to Caldera
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to speak earlier. As discussed, we want to license our RapidCure OOA cure process to Caldera Mobility for their eVTOL airframe programme. Can Whitfield Carter act for us on the licence? We'd like to get an NDA in place this week so we can share the process data.

Robert Falconer
CEO, Halstead Aerospace

messages.subject: RE: Project Skylark - licensing RapidCure to Caldera
messages.plaintextBody:
Robert,

Delighted to act. James Osei will be the day-to-day contact. I attach a mutual NDA ready for signature with Caldera - it covers the process data and the existence of the talks, 5-year confidentiality. Once that's signed we can move to heads of terms.

We'll open the matter as WC-00187 / Project Skylark.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
